dim1.label: structural_form_single_storey
dim1.description: Single-storey WikiHouse structural body. Rectangular wall zone from ground to eave (2400mm). Gable above eave to ridge (2161mm rise → 4561mm total). No mid-floor band. Total height 4561mm.
dim1.pass_criteria: Single-storey reading — no floor band; rectangular wall zone + triangular gable cap; eave line visible at approximately 2400mm (wall height ~53% of total 4561mm ridge)

dim2.label: roof_pitch_42deg
dim2.description: 42° gable pitch on STRUCTURAL 4800mm span. Rise=2161mm, ridge=4561mm. Roof zone (2161mm) is ~47% of total height (4561mm). Pitch noticeably steeper than Villa Verde's 24°. Gable triangle base=5436mm external, height=2161mm.
dim2.pass_criteria: Triangular gable peak clearly visible at top; roof zone occupies ~47% of total facade height; pitch appears steeper than a shallow domestic gable; ridge at ~4561mm total height

dim3.label: fenestration_3bay_symmetric
dim3.description: 3 openings: 1 centered door (S=1200mm wide, 2 bays, cx=2718mm) + 2 symmetric windows (S=1200mm wide each, bays 1-2 and bays 5-6). All on 600mm grid. Solid wall panels at each end. Single-storey — NO upper floor openings.
dim3.pass_criteria: 3 openings symmetric about facade center; center opening is taller (door to floor); flanking openings are square windows raised above sill; solid wall panels at each end; no upper floor openings

dim4.label: massing_landscape
dim4.description: Front facade landscape orientation — width(5436mm) > height(4561mm), ratio ~1.19:1. Single-storey character. Contrast with Villa Verde near-square (6096×6245mm).
dim4.pass_criteria: Building reads distinctly wider than tall; landscape aspect ratio ~1.2:1; clearly single-storey character different from Villa Verde

dim5.label: cladding_utilitarian
dim5.description: Light-colored wall zone (cream/white — prefab timber structural cladding). Distinct darker gray roof zone. Clean rectilinear gable-end form. No ornamentation.
dim5.pass_criteria: Light wall zone + dark roof zone; clean utilitarian gable-end form; no decorative elements
